title: Daemon command registry extraction
description: Objective: create room for the effect.activate ingress without growing the 397-line daemon-store-dependencies.ts past the split-before-400 rail. Deliverable: move the existing capability/family/payload-key maps, request injection, CommandRegistryEntry construction, registry assembly, and decision/refusal adapter into a focused daemon-command-registry module with its LF .js bridge; daemon-store-dependencies.ts delegates to it and preserves its current public compatibility exports/callers byte-for-byte in behavior. Consumer: task-e33747f982e0452a9f9d784fd1cb914d will add only the new effect.activate entry to the extracted seam. NOT in scope: registering effect.activate, changing authorization/payload policy, recovery reads, store schema, or activation behavior. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test && a plain-Node daemon default-provider construction smoke.
definitionOfDone: daemon-store-dependencies.ts delegates registry/decision construction to the new focused module and is reduced below 300 physical lines; no production source created or changed by the task reaches 400 lines.

All pre-existing command kinds retain the exact required capability, family, payload allow-list, injected store/project request fields, handler, refusal code/layer and replay behavior through handleCommandRequest(createStoreDependencies(...).provide()).
agentCapabilitiesFor remains available to agent-wrapper through the established daemon-local import or an explicit compatibility re-export; no caller is switched to a deep package import.
The new .js bridge is exact one-line LF `export * from './daemon-command-registry.ts';`, and the plain-Node default-provider smoke loads the real runtime path.
Focused daemon typecheck/tests pass and a mutation of one extracted capability or payload-key mapping reddens its named production-ingress test.
taskRails: This is a behavior-preserving extraction: do not add effect.activate or alter any existing command contract.
TDD/characterization tests assert exact command kind, capability, payload allow-list and refusal code/layer rather than only accepted/refused.
Preserve foreign work and stage/commit only explicit owned paths; target <=250 lines for the new production module and split before 400.
Use LF one-line runtime bridges and public package roots across package boundaries.
